metadata.label: NEAR close-ups
metadata.coverage: Two calibrated broadband images from the 1997 flyby. Original shadows and detector artifacts remain. Grid marks unavailable image coverage; the visualization shape includes modeled crater floors and unseen areas.

celestial.sunSource: Illustrative directional lighting in the published Mathilde mapping frame; source spin pole and phase are unknown
celestial.sunQualification: Illustrative directional lighting in Mathilde’s explicitly arbitrary J2000-parallel mapping frame. The source has no solved spin pole or rotational phase, so this is not an accurately timed body-fixed Sun solution. The Monochrome view separately retains NEAR encounter illumination and photographed shadows.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: Stooke and Pfau’s partial NEAR photomosaic retains photographed shadows and processing seams; it is not calibrated albedo. Gray grid marks exterior map gaps identified by a conservative connected-fill heuristic. The published Stooke visualization shape includes modeled unseen areas and aesthetically modified shadowed crater floors. Shadows adds illustrative lighting: the spin pole and phase are unresolved.

controls.label: NEAR close-ups
controls.notes: Two NEAR MSI broadband photographs from 27 June 1997, calibrated to I/F and registered to the published visualization shape using reconstructed flyby geometry and checked limb alignment. Photographed shadows, scattered light and detector noise remain. The raw companion images identify missing and saturated pixels; the archive quality index remains unresolved. Grid marks unavailable imagery.

controls.label: Elevation

legend.title: Elevation
legend.meta: km · 26.4 km reference sphere · partial coverage

controls.notes: Color shows Thomas model radius minus a 26.4 km reference sphere. Source samples carrying the unobserved 26.5 km placeholder are withheld before interpolation and shown as gray grid. This is radial height, not gravitational elevation. The displayed Stooke visualization shape separately includes modeled unseen areas and modified crater floors; it is not the measured elevation surface. Brightness adds cartographic relief; Shadows adds illustrative directional lighting.
